Spectra files must be centroided and in an open spectrum format (MGF, mzXML, mzML or mzData).
MetaMiner natively supports MGF, mzXML, mzData and uses msconvert utility from the ProteoWizard package to convert spectra in other formats to MGF.
MetaMiner accepts raw nucleotide sequences in .fasta format as genomic input. MetaMiner accepts predicted and translated RiPP amino acid sequences in .fasta format as genomic input.
MetaMiner accepts antiSMASH's .final.gbk or .gbk file as genomic input. MetaMiner accepts BOA's .annotated.txt file as genomic input.
Users can assemble DNA short reads with SPAdes or metaSPAdes before running MetaMiner.
MetaMiner reports all detected RiPPs in plain text tab-separated value files (.tsv).

MetaMiner enlarges the set of described RiPPs via spectral networking as a fourth pipeline step.
MetaMiner requires a 64-bit Linux system or macOS and Python versions 2.6-2.7, 3.3 and higher.
MetaMiner requires joblib Python library for parallel processing of multiple spectra or sequence files.
Without joblib installed, MetaMiner processes everything in a single thread.
